claims: Niele Ivey is the Karen & Kevin Keyes Family Head Women's Basketball Coach at Notre Dame.
Niele Ivey has held the position since 2020.
Niele Ivey succeeded Hall of Fame coach Muffet McGraw.
Niele Ivey has led the team to multiple Sweet Sixteen appearances.
Niele Ivey was a point guard for the Irish.
Niele Ivey was a 2001 NCAA champion.
Niele Ivey played for Notre Dame from 1996–2001.
Niele Ivey helped the team win its first national championship.
Niele Ivey played in the WNBA.
Niele Ivey served as an assistant coach at Notre Dame from 2007–2019.
Niele Ivey served as an assistant coach in the NBA with the Memphis Grizzlies.
A Facebook video notes fourth consecutive Sweet Sixteen appearances for the Fighting Irish under Niele Ivey.
According to Notre Dame Athletics, Carol Owens serves as the Associate Head Coach.
